name: What's the process for getting new kitchen countertops?

step.name: Step 1: Thinking about upgrading your kitchen countertops in Las Vegas?
step.text: Thinking about upgrading your kitchen countertops in Las Vegas? It's a fantastic way to refresh your space, but you might be wondering about the steps involved. Don't worry, it's pretty straightforward, especially when you work with experienced professionals like us at Simply Construction!

step.name: Step 2: First up, we'll have an initial consultation
step.text: First up, we'll have an initial consultation. This is where we chat about your vision, what materials you're eyeing (granite, quartz, marble – so many choices!), and your budget. We'll also take some preliminary measurements to give you an accurate estimate. After that, we help you pick out the perfect slab or material that fits your style and needs. Once you've made your selection, our team will come out for precise measurements. This is super important to ensure everything fits perfectly. Next, the old countertops are carefully removed, and the new ones are custom-fabricated off-site. The installation day arrives, and our skilled crew will expertly install your beautiful new countertops, making sure all seams are tight and finishes are flawless. We then do a final walkthrough with you to ensure you're absolutely thrilled with your refreshed kitchen. It's a smooth process designed to minimize disruption to your home while delivering stunning results.
